headline: Per-share earnings rise sharply versus a year earlier
summary_short: EPS was JPY 21.58, up 2.6% from JPY 21.04 in the prior quarter and up 161.0% from JPY 8.27 a year earlier.
summary_long: Only the per-share earnings figure is available on the shard. It rose 2.6% q/q and 161.0% y/y. A disclosure dated 11 November shows a revised full-year forecast with operating profit near JPY 26.5B, but its period labelling is unclear, so no reported revenue or operating profit is used here.
